ratios.title: Subsidized housing as a share of single-adult housing exits
ratios.historyNote: FY2022–2026 uses both components from the same five-year table in the FY2026 report. Definitions and chapter change notes were reviewed for this span; earlier years are not included.
ratios.question: What share of single adults leaving shelter for permanent housing went to subsidized housing?
ratios.caveat: Both counts require at least 30 days out of shelter and exclude Safe Havens and veterans’ short-term housing. This describes recorded exits, not whether a subsidy caused or was necessary for an exit.
ratios.numLabel: Single adults exiting to permanent housing — Subsidized
ratios.denLabel: Single adults exiting to permanent housing

ratios.title: Homeless applicants’ share of public-housing placements
ratios.historyNote: FY2022–2026 uses both components from the same five-year table in the FY2026 report. Definitions and chapter change notes were reviewed for this span; earlier years are not included.
ratios.question: What share of conventional NYCHA public-housing placements went to homeless applicants?
ratios.caveat: Both counts cover conventional public-housing placements. Section 8 placements are excluded. The share describes allocation among placements, not the share of homeless applicants who obtained housing.
ratios.numLabel: Homeless applicants placed in public housing — NYCHA housing

ratios.title: Default decisions as a share of OATH decisions
ratios.historyNote: FY2022–2026 uses both components from the same five-year table in the FY2026 report. Definitions and chapter change notes were reviewed for this span; earlier years are not included.
ratios.question: What share of OATH Hearings Division decisions were recorded in its default-decision category?
ratios.caveat: The category includes auto-defaults, defaults and guilty decisions after inquest hearings. These are decisions, not unique people. The share does not establish why someone did not contest a summons.

ratios.title: Taxi inspections passed as a share of inspections conducted
ratios.historyNote: FY2022–2026 uses both components from the same five-year table in the FY2026 report. Definitions and chapter change notes were reviewed for this span; earlier years are not included.
ratios.question: Taxi and Limousine prints inspections conducted and inspections passed. Their ratio shows the share of inspection events passed, including retests.
ratios.caveat: Both counts include initial inspections and retests. This is the share of inspection events passed, not a first-pass rate or the share of unique taxis that are roadworthy. The MMR separately publishes the initial-inspection failure rate.
ratios.numLabel: Medallion taxi safety and emissions inspections conducted – Passed
ratios.denLabel: Medallion taxi safety and emissions inspections conducted – Total

ratios.title: Overtime as a share of Correction Department spending
ratios.historyNote: FY2021–2025 uses final prior-year actuals from the FY2022–2026 PMMR resource tables. Both components retain the same overtime/expenditure scope and monetary units. No FY2026 budget plan is used.
ratios.question: What share of total agency expenditures went to overtime?
ratios.caveat: Overtime divided by total agency expenditures, not payroll. Changes can reflect overtime, other spending, or both; this is not a measure of service quality.
